description: Planted-disqualifier rules for the synthetic patients in data/patients. kind 'criterion': a trial counts toward the denominator when its eligibility text matches criteria_regex (case-insensitive); it is a hit when some assessment is an exclusion with status met or an inclusion with status not_met, cites at least one of correct_refs, and the verdict is not likely_eligible. kind 'hard_check': a trial counts when the code hard check (age, sex) fails for the patient; it is a hit when the verdict is likely_ineligible. Patients without a rule (p001, p005, p008) are clean.

p002.issue: renal impairment (latest eGFR about 24, CKD stage 4)
